parsed.faithful: The latter are again divided into two other fields; pure rabbinists, explain the scripture, in its natural sense, by grammar, history, and tradition; and cabbalists, who, to discover hidden mythical fancies, which they suppose God to have couched therein, make use of the cabbala, and the mythical methods above mentioned.
